rows.name: Stretch
rows.pay_note: Record dates the 15th and month-end; daily dividends for Nov 1–30 conditionally declared at 12.00% ($1.00/share in total), payable only if the Oct 28 vote passes
rows.next_ex_note: Record date for the Nov 15 payment ($0.50/share), which applies only if the Oct 28 daily-dividend vote fails; if it passes, daily record dates start Nov 1 (first payment Nov 2)
rows.explain: Strategy's variable-rate preferred: Strategy resets the rate to keep the price near $100 (12.00% for periods from Oct 16, 2026, and for November record dates, per its Oct 1 and Oct 16 8-Ks). Dividends are cumulative.

rows.name: Strife
rows.pay_note: Mar 31 / Jun 30 / Sep 30 / Dec 31, when declared
rows.next_ex_note: Q4 dividend not declared yet (scheduled pay date Dec 31)
rows.explain: Most senior of Strategy's preferreds: a fixed 10% rate on $100, and missed dividends accrue (cumulative).

rows.name: Strike
rows.pay_note: Mar 31 / Jun 30 / Sep 30 / Dec 31, when declared; cash, MSTR stock or both
rows.next_ex_note: Q4 dividend not declared yet (scheduled pay date Dec 31)
rows.explain: Fixed 8% rate on $100 plus an equity link: each share can convert into 0.1 MSTR share. Dividends can be paid in cash, MSTR stock or both.

rows.name: Stride
rows.pay_note: Mar 31 / Jun 30 / Sep 30 / Dec 31, when declared
rows.next_ex_note: Q4 dividend not declared yet (scheduled pay date Dec 31)
rows.explain: Most junior Strategy preferred: a fixed 10% rate, but dividends are at the board's discretion and skipped ones never accrue (non-cumulative). That is why it usually trades at the highest effective yield.

rows.pay_note: Each business day; November: $0.0571/share a day (19 business days, $1.0849 in total), record date the prior business day

rows.next_ex_note: Every business day; 13.00% maintained for November (Strive 8-K, Oct 13)

rows.name: SATS
rows.pay_note: Each business day from Nov 9, 2026: first payment $0.8710/share (accrued Oct 21–Nov 9, record date Nov 6), then $0.0658/share each business day Nov 10–30

rows.next_ex_note: Record date for the first dividend ($0.8710/share, paid Nov 9); then the prior business day for each daily payment

Quoted in pounds on the LSE, so it is listed here rather than in the US-dollar table.

news_week._note: Sunday refresh: News of the Week. Max 8 material items from the past Mon-Sun, grouped in this order: strategy (Strategy & Saylor), treasury (other big treasury companies: Strive/ASST, Metaplanet...), industry (index/regulatory/capital-markets news for the sector, other companies), bitcoin (price milestones, network, ETFs, adoption, crypto regulation) (omit a group with nothing material). One line each, date, official source preferred (SEC/TSE filing, company press release, regulator, index provider, Farside for ETF flows). BEFORE replacing, append the old news_week object to assets/data/news_archive.json weeks[] (newest first). Mark the 3 most material items with "top": 1 (shown when the card is collapsed). Each item also gets "why": one line, 'Why it matters for holders' (plain, factual, no advice). Mark the week's single biggest item "lead": 1 (the bold Top story; any group). 'On deck next week' is built automatically from desk.json week_ahead.
news_week.label: Oct 19 – 25, 2026

items.text: Bought 267 BTC ($22.1M, avg $82,900) to reach 848,517 BTC, funded by $22.0M of MSTR sales; repurchased $193.1M of STRC (1.94M shares) and raised its digital credit repurchase program from $2.0B to $3.0B ($1.16B left). No preferred ATM sales.
items.why: A second straight week of STRC buybacks paid from USD Cash rather than new issuance; STRC closed the week at $99.36, close to its $100 par. USD Reserve: $4.83B.

items.text: Coming: special meeting on daily preferred dividends Wed Oct 28 (10:00 AM ET, same day as the Fed decision), then Q3 2026 results Thu Oct 29 after the close with a live webinar at 5:00 PM ET.
items.why: If the vote passes, STRC moves to a record date every calendar day from Nov 1; Q3 results bring the quarter's official BTC Yield, BTC Gain and balance-sheet figures.

items.text: Strive closed its upsized SATS preferred IPO (7,000,000 shares at $90) and SATS began trading on Nasdaq; on Oct 21 it declared the first dividend ($0.8710/share, paid Nov 9) and daily $0.0658 payments for Nov 10–30, a 15.00% rate.
items.why: SATS ranks below SATA, adding junior capital beneath it; it closed its first week at $94.88, about a 15.8% yield on the $100 stated amount.

items.text: Strive bought 1,223 more BTC (avg $81,734) over Oct 14–16 to reach 36,818 BTC, keeping #4 among public companies; its traditional warrants are now all exercised or expired.
items.why: Assumed fully diluted shares rose to 126.8M after the warrant exercises; BitcoinTreasuries.NET shows its mNAV at 1.25.

items.text: Super League (SLE) stockholders approved every proposal tied to Metaplanet's planned 2,100 BTC plus $2.5M cash investment; on closing the company becomes Superplanet, Inc. (Nasdaq: SUPA), expected in Q4 2026.
items.why: Metaplanet's route to a US-listed bitcoin treasury vehicle; closing is still subject to customary conditions.

items.text: Alpha Modus (AMOD) disclosed 3,170 BTC held by its Singapore subsidiary, acquired Sep 30 in a PIPE paid in bitcoin, entering the public-company top 30 (#27 on BitcoinTreasuries.NET).
items.why: The deal issued about 51.6M shares plus as many $4.36 warrants; full cash exercise could add about $225M.

items.text: Smarter Web (SWC) bought 20 BTC (avg £61,733) to reach 2,850 BTC and reported a 2.41% quarter-to-date BTC Yield.
items.why: Steady weekly adds from the UK's largest listed bitcoin treasury; its "MORE" preferred paid its first weekly dividend record date Oct 23.

items.text: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $301.2M over Oct 19–23: +$526.7M Monday and +$524.8M Wednesday, then −$635.6M Thursday and −$137.9M Friday (one fund not yet reported).
items.why: Flows turned positive after last week's $228.4M outflow, but reversed late in the week ahead of the Oct 28 Fed decision.
